title: Pooled CRISPR screens identifies key regulators of bovine stem cell expansion for cultured meat [Long-Term screen]
model: Adipose-derived bovine MSCs (Cas9), pre-cultured ~75 days then transduced at high MOI; same 3,000-guide library as GSE280676 (2,564 guides on 603 genes, 436 non-cutting controls), 100-day time course
contrast: Day 15 vs day 1 (3 vs 3), median-ratio totals; day 10 and day 30 as checks
paper_calls: TP53 the dominant long-term proliferation-enhancer; OSR2 and non-cutting nc_guide2480 enrichment attributed to high-MOI co-inheritance
barcs_calls: 11 enriched genes at FDR 0.10 at day 15 (TP53 #1); OSR2 and nc_guide2480 not called
named_hits: TP53 recovered as #1 enriched (FDR 5.6e-6); passenger artifacts (OSR2, nc_guide2480) correctly not called
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's single firm long-term conclusion: TP53 is the top enriched knockout at day 15 with all guides concordant, while the OSR2 and non-cutting-control enrichments the paper flags as high-MOI passengers are discounted by guide aggregation. Beyond day 20 the library collapses to a few clones and nothing is interpretable.
